description: Frozen batch-6 cases for the batch Garden Note contract (ADR-0085 N8): one note becomes up to 12 reviewed records across the three showcase gardens and five care types. Each case lists the drafts and notices the server should return; a missing expected key means the value stays empty. 'ideal' is the extraction a perfect model would return and is never sent; the tests use it to prove every expectation is reachable under the server's rules. Changing anything here changes the batch fingerprint, which refuses further paid runs. Batch 6 keeps batch 5's 38 cases and adds 10 holdout cases written after batch 5's results and before any batch-6 request.
